sources.title: Phison and Kingston Collaborate on NVMe SSD Controller to Accelerate into the Next SSD-era
sources.effective_period: Historical collaboration and cumulative shipments reported as of 2017-12-06
sources.note: Phison reports controller shipments to Kingston exceeding 18 million units and a history of supplying Kingston since 2012. This establishes a customer relationship, not a largest-customer ranking.

sources.note: Kingston describes Phison as a long-term strategic technology partner and says many Kingston products use Phison controllers. It does not identify Kingston as Phison's largest customer.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches and review of official Phison and Kingston materials found relationship evidence but no reliable evidence defining and substantiating the claimed customer ranking; the ranking remains unresolved.
The cited primary sources document a historical partnership and product relationship; neither supplies a customer ranking.
The claim has no stated period or ranking measure, and the available relationship evidence cannot substitute for customer-level sales or revenue-share data.
